lines: World loading now counts the shaders it builds, and says how smoothly the world will run.
The programs are built in batches, each one counted, through the same pass the ride draws with, so nothing is built twice.
Then the first frames warm up at the starting quality, and the card says the frame rate they held at Low.
After twenty seconds without the world, the card says it is taking longer than usual, and why.
Start at Low quality, ride with the panorama, or keep waiting; a build that fails steps down a level.
The warning and its choices, from a phone to the full screen.
What the tests prove: the programs are counted, the frame rate is held, and a slow load offers a way out.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
